title: Symmetry reverses an exact dual pair
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a symmetric monoidal category: a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with natural symmetry $\sigma_{A,B}:A\otimes B\xrightarrow{\sim}B\otimes A$, satisfying the two hexagon equations and $\sigma_{B,A}\sigma_{A,B}=1$. Let $P,Q\in\mathcal C$ have maps $e:Q\otimes P\to\mathbf1$ and $b:\mathbf1\to P\otimes Q$ satisfying $(1_P\otimes e)(b\otimes1_P)=1_P$ and $(e\otimes1_Q)(1_Q\otimes b)=1_Q$, with canonical associators and unitors understood. Then $Q,P$ with evaluation $e\circ\sigma_{P,Q}:P\otimes Q\to\mathbf1$ and coevaluation $\sigma_{P,Q}\circ b:\mathbf1\to Q\otimes P$ satisfy both triangle identities.
